why: Hex-Rays lost 12 bytes of stack depth before the SetTexture call and read arguments a2 and a3 as v121/v122, slots past the end of the 4-argument frame (ret 0x10). The two arguments are otherwise unused in its output.
evidence: disasm 0x10185E52: at depth 0x128 (sub esp,0x118 + 4 saved registers) `mov edx,[esp+0x134]` (a3) is pushed as SetTexture's texture; 0x10185E7B `mov eax,[esp+0x130]` (a2) is the float* whose [0] and [2] feed fpatan.
